D1.cause: BatchPage rendered LayoutQuestion, IfcStructure, PageImageQuestion and BatchTableSection as siblings, each with key={current.itemId}. BatchTableSection renders for every chosen item, so any item with a layout, structure or page-image section gave two siblings one key, again on every refresh of the batch.
D1.fix: One ItemDetail component keyed once by the item renders the sections in place, without keys of their own; a new item still starts every section afresh. The waiting-file list keys by name and size and counts a repeat, instead of the index.
D1.checked: Every other list on the page keys by a unique id: the tray rows (itemId), evidence profiles and sources (profileId, itemId), run confirmations (de-duplicated ids), packages (packageId), targets (targetId), IFC lines (stepId), the drop outcomes table (row index).

D2.cause: The words read back after a reload were only cleared by Dismiss; nothing told the notice when a named file finished or was cancelled.
D2.fix: UnfinishedUploads reports a receipt whose file finished and was enrolled, or whose upload was cancelled (or ended while cancelling); the batch page drops that name and size from the words and from sessionStorage. A file whose name and size appear as an item of the batch (picked again through Add files and finished) is dropped too. The notice leaves when no file is left; Dismiss still clears it at once.

D3.cause: A table imported from the dialog always navigated to its table page, which unmounts the batch page and the dialog, so the drop's other files were lost and the batch page's 'Continue with other files' was gone.
D3.fix: When other files of the drop are still to route, the table import hands the read table back to the dialog: the row reads 'Imported as a table · open the table' (a link to the table page), the other rows keep their route words, a status line names the imported table, and 'Continue with other files' takes the next file to its route (Retain for batch files, the table import for a table). A table that is the last file of its drop opens its page as before. A continuation opened from the batch page reports the files still to route, so its header button and the reload words follow them.
D3.afterTJ1: TJ1 (merged in 5f92d072) keeps a CSV dropped with map files, or on the batch page, in the batch as an item, so the REH9 drop of a CSV and two map files no longer reaches the table import at all. The table import with other files waiting still happens for a drop of several tables outside a batch and under the opt-in NYC profile; the D3 test uses two CSVs, and also checks the CSV-plus-two-maps drop retains all three together.
